prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished landscape architectural production concept sheet for BeatMakka Needle Quay. Use the supplied approved board as visual authority: chunky soft bevels, subtly asymmetrical lived-in port architecture, faded teal paint, warm cream trims, walnut wood, dusty coral, oxidized brass, restrained amber light. Forgotten but cared for, never destroyed, no cyberpunk neon, no real brands. The board is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, do not reproduce its collage or unrelated props. Sheet on warm off-white paper, premium legible editorial layout. Large colored isometric view on left; consistent smaller FRONT / SIDE / TOP schematic views on right; a pair of BEFORE / AFTER small same-geometry lighting views at bottom. Diagrammatic architectural concept, not engineering-certified orthographics. Include sparse readable English labels, material swatches, blue dimension arrows. No gameplay instructions baked into textures. Title and asset ID clearly readable. Keep all views consistent; no crowds. Building: THE LANTERN ROOM, NQ-BLD-01. Envelope WIDTH 44 / DEPTH 30 / HEIGHT 26 studs; broad low former music hall, brick body with faded teal rounded entrance portal, old brass-letter marquee, two large closed windows, visible SIDE SERVICE DOOR. An intimate old port music venue, not a lighthouse tower and not a record shop. Roof stays within the envelope. Top plan diagram labels LOBBY, HALL, STAGE with entrance centered on front and side service route. Interior lobby 40x6, hall 40x14, rear stage 28x6 is conceptual fit within envelope, no partitions obstruct main entrance. Ronan Wren's host position as simple tiny location dot only. After state turns on amber marquee/windows, a subtle concert poster and open entrance; before dark windows and faded sign. SAME building geometry before/after. Material swatches sea-worn brick, cream, teal, walnut, brass. Footer: CONCEPT CANDIDATE / ART REVIEW PENDING. Do not add balconies, towers or extra stories.
